description: This plot illustrates the comparison of Macro-F1 Score (%) across different numbers of tokens for two methods. The x-axis is labeled "Number of tokens" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 1.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis is labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from approximately 47 to 59, with tick marks at intervals of 2 from 48 to 58. The plot contains two solid lines, both featuring circular markers and surrounded by shaded regions representing variance. The pink line, representing "MATTER (ours)", begins at an x-value of 0.5 with a y-value of approximately 55.1, dips slightly to 54.3 at x=0.7, and then rises to a peak of approximately 57.9 at x=1.0. Following this peak, it generally declines, with a slight rise at x=1.4 (y≈53.5), before ending at x=1.5 with a y-value of approximately 50.9. The purple line, representing "w/o material information", starts at x=0.5 with a y-value of approximately 52.5, reaches its peak at x=0.7 with a y-value of approximately 54.1, and then exhibits a gradual decline to 51.7 at x=1.3. It then rises to 53.3 at x=1.4 before experiencing a sharp drop to end at x=1.5 with a y-value of approximately 47.9.
caption_used: Comparison of Macro-F1 scores for MATTER and w/o material knowledge during tokenization training across different numbers of tokens. The pink line representing MATTER (ours) starts at approximately 55% Macro-F1 Score, peaks at 58% near x=1.0, and ends at 50% near x=1.3, showing a consistent decline after its peak. The purple line, representing w/o material information, begins at 52.5%, peaks at 56% near x=0.7, and then stabilizes around 50% for the remainder of the range. The shaded areas indicate variance, with significant overlap between the two conditions near x=1.2. The results suggest that MATTER consistently outperforms the alternative across all token counts, with a sharper decline in performance at higher token counts for both conditions.
